about: The free-plugin report standard's shared eval graders. Edit here, then run: python3 free-plugin-standard/sync_graders.py. CI runs it with --check. See STANDARD.md.

always.name: std-no-fix-prompt
always.pattern: To fix:|make every other place use it|in one place and make|Put the rule for|Put each (?:decision|rule) in one place|here is (?:the|a) fix|change (?:line|the code)|start a new conversation|make the fixes|move the rule into|consolidat|here'?s (?:the|a) fix|want me to fix|I can (?:fix|make)|(?:new|follow-up) (?:chat|conversation)|merge the two|replace line

always.name: std-coverage-line
always.pattern: (?:^|\n)(?:We read all \d+ of your code files\.|We read \d+ of your \d+ code files\. Problems in the others can be missed\.|We read \d+ code files\. Problems in files we did not read can be missed\.)

exempt.inside-app: stops before any report: it only tells the founder to run the census from the folder above the app
exempt.near-miss: the census does not run: the prompt asks for a code review, so no report is rendered
exempt.asks-stopline-first: ends at the stop-line question before any report: the host can ask and nothing settles it (plan D1)

omit.std-check-it: 0.6.0 (SCOPE.md, Lauren 2026-10-21): the report says what is broken and what it means, never what to do, so its blocks carry no check line.

words.std-count-line:
(?:^|
)\*\*We found (?:\d+|no) problems? in your code, and [^
*]+\.\*\*[ 	]*(?=
|$)
